english.title: Leave List ' B ' prohibited article in / outside prison intending it come into possession of prisoner - Prison Act 1952
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), without authorisation, left

(A)_[an article, namely **(..SPECIFY THE ARTICLE..),]_
(B)_[a substance, namely **(..SPECIFY THE SUBSTANCE..),]_

which was specified by section 40A(3) of the Prison Act 1952, at **(..SPECIFY THE LOCATION..), intending that it would come into the possession of a prisoner
english.legislation: Contrary to section 40C(1)(c) and (5) of the Prison Act 1952.

english.notes:
(i) This offence was substituted for section 40 of the Prison Act 1952 by section 22 of the Offender Management Act 2007 with effect from 01/04/08.
(ii) Section 40A(3) of the Prison Act 1952 provides that such a List ' B ' prohibited article includes -
(a) alcohol (as defined for the purposes of the Licensing Act 2003);
(b) a mobile telephone;
(c) a camera;
(d) a sound-recording device.
(iii) See subsection 40C(7) of the Prison Act 1952 which provides that in this section "authorisation" means authorisation given for the purposes of this section; and subsections (1) to (3) of section 40E apply in relation to authorisations so given as they apply to authorisations given for the purposes of section 40D.
(iv) Section 40C(4) of the Prison Act 1952 provides a defence.

other.penalty:
Either way
Summary: maximum 6/12 months imprisonment and/or a fine not exceeding the statutory maximum.
Indictment: maximum 2 years imprisonment and/or a fine.

The maximum penalty on summary conviction is 6 months for offences committed before 2nd May 2022; for offences committed on or after that date it may be 6 or 12 months depending on the general limit in a magistrates’ court, see paragraph 5 of Schedule 4 to the Offender Management Act 2007 and section 224(1) and (1A) of the Sentencing Act 2022.
On the 12th March 2015 the limit on fines imposed by a Magistrates’ court was removed – as such, the potential fine on summary conviction in relation to an offence committed after this date is unlimited.

Time limit for prosecutions:
None
